author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is too true, however disgraceful it may be to human nature, that nations in general will make war whenever they have a prospect of getting anything by it; nay, absolute monarchs will often make war when their nations are to get nothing by it, but for the purposes and objects merely personal, such as thirst for military glory, revenge for personal affronts, ambition, or private compacts to aggrandize or support their particular families or partisans. These and a variety of other motives, which affect only the mind of the sovereign, often lead him to engage in wars not sanctified by justice or the voice and interests of his people.

jyutping: mou4 leon6 deoi3 jan4 sing3 jau5 gei2 lei4 pou2，jat1 bun1 gwok3 gaa1 mui5 dong1 jau5 cin4 ging2 ho2 ji5 dak1 dou3 jam6 ho4 je5 ge3 si4 hau6，dou1 wui6 faat3 dung6 zin3 zaang1，ni1 go3 hai6 taai3 zan1 sat6 ge3；m4 hai6，dong1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwok3 gaa1 mou5 dak1 dou3 jam6 ho4 je5 ge3 si4 hau6，zyut6 deoi3 gwan1 zyu2 tung1 soeng4 wui6 faat3 dung6 zin3 zaang1，daan6 hai6 muk6 dik1 tung4 muk6 dik1 zi2 hai6 go3 jan4 ge3，lai6 jyu4 deoi3 gwan1 si6 gwong1 waan4 ge3 hot3 mong6、deoi3 go3 jan4 mou5 juk6 ge3 bou3 sau4、je5 sam1，waak6 ze2 si1 jan4 kai3 joek3 heoi3 kwok3 daai6 waak6 ze2 zi1 ci4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 dak6 ding6 gaa1 zuk6 waak6 ze2 dong2 jyun4。ni1 di1 tung4 kei4 taa1 gok3 zung2 dung6 gei1，zi2 hai6 jing2 hoeng2 zyu2 kyun4 ze2 ge3 sam1 ling4，hou2 do1 si4 dou1 wui6 ling6 keoi5 caam1 jyu5 m4 sau6 zing3 ji6 waak6 ze2 keoi5 jan4 man4 ge3 sing1 jam1 tung4 lei6 jik1 so2 sing3 faa3 ge3 zin3 zaang1。
text: 無論對人性有幾離譜，一般國家每當有前景可以得到任何嘢嘅時候，都會發動戰爭，呢個係太真實嘅；唔係，當佢哋嘅國家冇得到任何嘢嘅時候，絕對君主通常會發動戰爭，但係目的同目的只係個人嘅，例如對軍事光環嘅渴望、對個人侮辱嘅報仇、野心，或者私人契約去擴大或者支持佢哋嘅特定家族或者黨員。呢啲同其他各種動機，只係影響主權者嘅心靈，好多時都會令佢參與唔受正義或者佢人民嘅聲音同利益所聖化嘅戰爭。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Both my parents grew up Roman Catholic in the Philippines. In the 1970s there, my father liked reading the paranormal genre, like books by Erich von Däniken and Tuesday Lobsang Rampa. So, he then even liked non-Xtian ideas. My parents, in the 1980s, converted to Protestant Baptists several years after landing in Canada. But my father continued reading the paranormal genre, like books by Deepak Chopra and James Redfield. He believed in meditation and rebirth or reincarnation. He recounted to me his afterlife scenario that his "mind" would migrate to a newborn baby on a faraway "planet," and there he would grow up in a new life. I showed to my parents my elaborate Buddhist temple, and my father was on the verge of reading literature from there. My father passed away in 2013.

jyutping: ngo5 fu6 mou5 dou1 hai6 hai2 fei1 leot6 ban1 ge3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 tou4 zoeng2 daai6。hai2 go2 dou6 ge3 1970 nin4 doi6，ngo5 baa4 baa1 zung1 ji3 tai2 ciu1 zi6 jin4 leoi6 jing4 ge3 syu1，lai6 jyu4 aai1 lei5 hei1 · fung4 · daan1 nei4 hang2 tung4 Tuesday · lok3 song1 · laan4 paak3 ge3 syu1。so2 ji5，keoi5 dong1 si4 sam6 zi3 zung1 ji3 fei1 Xtian ge3 nam2 faat3。ngo5 fu6 mou5 hai2 1980 nin4 doi6，hai2 dang1 luk6 gaa1 naa4 daai6 gei2 nin4 hau6 goi2 seon3 san1 gaau3 zam3 seon3 wui2。daan6 hai6 ngo5 baa4 baa1 gai3 zuk6 tai2 ciu1 zi6 jin4 leoi6 jing4 ge3 syu1，hou2 ci5 dik6 paak3 hak1 · kiu4 pou2 laai1 tung4 zim1 si6 · leoi4 dak1 fei2 ji5 dak1 ge3 syu1 gam2。keoi5 soeng1 seon3 ming5 soeng2 tung4 cung4 sang1 waak6 ze2 zyun2 sai3。keoi5 tung4 ngo5 gong2 faan2 keoi5 ge3 sei2 hau6 cing4 fong3，keoi5 ge3「sam1 ling4」wui5 zyun2 ji4 dou3 jat1 go3 hai2 jyun5 fong1 ge3「sing1 kau4」soeng6 ge3 san1 sang1 jing1 ji4，jin4 hau6 hai2 go2 dou6 keoi5 wui5 hai2 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 sang1 ming6 jap6 min6 sing4 zoeng2。ngo5 hoeng3 fu6 mou5 zin2 si6 ngo5 zing1 sam1 zai3 zok3 ge3 fat6 zi2，ji4 ngo5 baa4 baa1 zau6 hai2 go2 dou6 duk6 man4 hok6 ge3 bin1 jyun4。ngo5 go3 fu6 can1 hai2 2013 nin4 gwo3 san1。
text: 我父母都係喺菲律賓嘅羅馬天主教徒長大。喺嗰度嘅1970年代，我爸爸鍾意睇超自然類型嘅書，例如埃里希 · 馮 · 丹尼肯同Tuesday · 洛桑 · 蘭帕嘅書。所以，佢當時甚至鍾意非 Xtian 嘅諗法。我父母喺1980年代，喺登陸加拿大幾年後改信新教浸信會。但係我爸爸繼續睇超自然類型嘅書，好似迪帕克 · 喬普拉同占士 · 雷德菲爾德嘅書噉。佢相信冥想同重生或者轉世。佢同我講返佢嘅死後情況，佢嘅「心靈」會轉移到一個喺遠方嘅「星球」上嘅新生嬰兒，然後喺嗰度佢會喺一個新嘅生命入面成長。我向父母展示我精心製作嘅佛寺，而我爸爸就喺嗰度讀文學嘅邊緣。我個父親喺2013年過身。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the morning of the 26th of March of 2023, Greg and I, both Filipinos, were talking in the teahouse, as I had my nth order of Strawberry Oat Matcha Latte and Greg, having already finished his coffee, attended to his newspapers and magazines. The barista at the cashier was Stefania, a beautiful black-haired Italian with an accent. Marlin, my Filipina friend, was sitting at a corner near the window. Near the counter stood a handsome head-shaven Japanese-looking man who was fluent in English. Greg and I discussed martial arts. There were the karate, judo, aikido, and kendo in Japan. There was the kung fu in China. There was the capoeira in Brazil. There was the arnis de mano in the Philippines. We mentioned Bruce Lee and Jackie Chan, famous martial artists in the movie industry.

jyutping: hai2 2023 nin4 3 jyut6 26 hou6 ge3 ziu1 zou2，ngo5 tung4 gaak3 leoi4 gaak3，loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 fei1 leot6 ban1 jan4，hai2 caa4 lau4 king1 gan2 gai3，jan1 wai6 ngo5 giu3 zo2 ngo5 dai6 n ci3 ge3 cou2 mui2 jin3 mak6 mut3 caa4 naa4 tit3，ji4 gaak3 leoi4 gaak3，ji5 ging1 jam2 jyun4 gaa3 fe1，heoi3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 bou3 zi2 tung4 zaap6 zi3 dou6。sau1 ngan2 ge3 gaa3 fe1 si1 hai6 Stefania ，jat1 go3 jau5 hau2 jam1 ge3 leng3 hak1 faat3 ji3 daai6 lei6 jan4。ngo5 fei1 leot6 ban1 pang4 jau5 maa5 lam4 zo6 hai2 coeng1 bin1 go3 gok3 lok6。gwai6 toi2 fu6 gan6 kei5 zo2 go3 leng3 zai2 tai3 tau4 jat6 bun2 jan4 joeng6 ge3 naam4 jan2，jing1 man2 lau4 lei6。ngo5 tung4 Greg tou2 leon6 zo2 mou5 seot6。jat6 bun2 jau5 hung1 sau2 dou6、jau4 dou6、hap6 hei3 dou6 tung4 gim3 dou6。hoeng1 gong2 jau5 gung1 fu1。baa1 sai1 jau5 kaa1 bo1 je4 laai1。fei1 leot6 ban1 jau5 go3 aa3 nei4 si1 dak1 maa5 nok6。ngo5 dei6 tai4 dou3 zo2 din6 jing2 gaai3 ge3 zyu3 ming4 mou5 seot6 gaa1 lei5 siu2 lung4 tung4 sing4 lung4。
text: 喺2023年3月26號嘅朝早，我同格雷格，兩個都係菲律賓人，喺茶樓傾緊計，因為我叫咗我第 n 次嘅草莓燕麥抹茶拿鐵，而格雷格，已經飲完咖啡，去咗佢嘅報紙同雜誌度。收銀嘅咖啡師係 Stefania ，一個有口音嘅靚黑髮意大利人。我菲律賓朋友馬林坐喺窗邊個角落。櫃台附近企咗個靚仔剃頭日本人樣嘅男人，英文流利。我同 Greg 討論咗武術。日本有空手道、柔道、合氣道同劍道。香港有功夫。巴西有卡波耶拉。菲律賓有個阿尼斯德馬諾。我哋提到咗電影界嘅著名武術家李小龍同成龍。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I have studied religiology for many years, as I have compared different religions around this world. I am not a gullible person, as many less educated are. My tendency is Animism-Buddhism. But being in this world where a third are influenced by Xtianity, I have to somewhat reconcile my pagan (or non-Abrahamic) beliefs with the Xtians around me.

jyutping: ngo5 duk6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 zung1 gaau3 hok6，jan1 wai6 ngo5 bei2 gaau3 gwo3 ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 gok3 dei6 ge3 m4 tung4 zung1 gaau3。ngo5 m4 hai6 jat1 go3 ji6 seon3 ge3 jan4，hou2 ci5 hou2 do1 sau6 gwo3 gaau3 siu2 gaau3 juk6 ge3 jan4 gam2。ngo5 ge3 king1 hoeng3 hai6 dung6 mat6 zyu2 ji6 - fat6 gaau3。daan6 hai6 hai2 ni1 go3 saam1 fan1 jat1 ge3 jan4 sau6 dou3 Xtianity jing2 hoeng2 ge3 sai3 gaai3 jap6 min6，ngo5 jiu3 tung4 ngo5 san1 bin1 ge3 Xtian jan4 jau5 di1 tiu4 wo4 ngo5 ge3 ji6 gaau3（waak6 ze2 fei1 aa3 baak3 laai1 hon2 seon3 joeng5）。
text: 我讀咗好多年宗教學，因為我比較過呢個世界各地嘅唔同宗教。我唔係一個易信嘅人，好似好多受過較少教育嘅人噉。我嘅傾向係動物主義 - 佛教。但係喺呢個三分一嘅人受到 Xtianity 影響嘅世界入面，我要同我身邊嘅 Xtian 人有啲調和我嘅異教（或者非亞伯拉罕信仰）。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The third day after this was the birthday of Pharaoh: and he made a great feast for his servants, and at the banquet remembered the chief butler, and the chief baker. And he restored the one to his place, to present him the cup. The other he hanged on a gibbet, that the truth of the interpreter might be shewn.

text: 之後第三日係法老嘅生日，佢為佢啲僕人開咗個大宴會，喺宴會上記住咗首席管家同首席麵包師。佢就將嗰個放返喺佢嘅位置，將個杯送畀佢。另一個佢掛喺吊架上面，等口譯員嘅真相可以顯示出嚟。
